# DIARRHEA WITH CRYPTOSPORIDIUM PARVUM

Antibiotic therapy is usually used only for persons with severe disease or
immunocompromised persons.

# Antimicrobial treatment for patients with advanced HIV

Consult Infectious Diseases

# _______________________________________________________________________________

References:

Guidelines for Prevention and Treatment of Opportunistic Infections in HIV
Infected Adults and Adolescents. AIDSinfo (2015) 1-282
Sanford Guide article: Cryptosporidiosis
DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017,
65(12):45-80
Up-to-Date article: Cryptosporidiosis: Treatment and prevention
Therapy:
## Primary treatment

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

## Antimicrobial treatment for immunocompromised patients

[Nitazoxanide 500 mg PO q12h for 3 days M](psjzid-nitazoxanide-500mg-po-q12h)
